title: The Influence Brief
subtitle: Negotiation, Persuasion & Stakeholder Craft for Product Executives
description: A practical series on the half of the executive job nobody trains you for: moving people. Stakeholder mapping, currencies of exchange, the trust equation, negotiation under power asymmetry, executive communication, and managing up — each episode gives you one working tool and one realistic product-org scenario to apply it in.
author: Sloane Bishop & Victor Reyes
